The fallback logic that reads raw_status directly from the status file will never execute because STATUS_FILE_PATH is always empty in this step's context.; If steps.collect_status.outputs.raw_status is unavailable for any reason (earlier step failure, output propagation issue), the fallback path to read raw_status from the status artifact is broken in this step. The code sets raw_status="${raw_status:-${status_value}}" which would use status_value as fallback instead of the potentially more accurate raw_status from the file. This can lead to incorrect raw_status in memory records and metadata when step outputs are missing.; Evidence: Compare env blocks:; - Record validation candidate (lines 502-508): declares STATUS_FILE_PATH; - Record validation run end (lines 621-626): does NOT declare STATUS_FILE_PATH but contains identical fallback pattern (line 654)

  [3] File: .github/workflows/validate.yml (line ~654)
      Problem: The shell code references `STATUS_FILE_PATH` but this environment variable is NOT declared in this specific step's `env:` block.; The shell uses `${STATUS_FILE_PATH:-}`, which safely expands to an empty string when the variable is missing. Consequently, the condition `[ -n "${STATUS_FILE_PATH:-}" ]` will always be false. This causes the file-reading fallback logic (using `jq` to read `.raw_status`) to be unreachable. While the step doesn't crash, the intended robustness mechanism for retrieving `raw_status` from the status artifact is non-functional in this step.
